entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: You're safe! You could've let me know or[n]something!
entries.uk: Цілі! Могли б хоч якось[n]дати знати!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I mean, the whole goddamn city was all[n]weird and pink!
entries.uk: Усе кляте місто було якесь[n]химерне й рожеве!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...But I guess you guys did something[n]about that, right?
entries.uk: ...Але ви, певно, якось[n]дали цьому раду, так?

entries.en: I don't know what you mean.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Heh. It's pretty obvious it was you guys.
entries.uk: Хе. Цілком очевидно, що це ви.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I guess I don't really even need to ask.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: No! I'll get laughed at if I cry!
entries.uk: Ні! Якщо заплачу, з мене сміятимуться!

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: ...It was pretty cold out there, wasn't it?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: I'll fix you two something warm...
